claims.text: ↑preeclampsia risk: low-dose ASA 81 mg/day after 12 wks
claims.quote: The USPSTF recommends the use of low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) as preventive medication after 12 weeks of gestation in persons who are at high risk for preeclampsia.
claims.locator: USPSTF Recommendation: Aspirin Use to Prevent Preeclampsia and Related Morbidity and Mortality: Preventive Medication (September 28, 2021)
